correctness.rationale: For random coefficients A,B∈{a,b}, exact squared-norm multiplier q=(1−sAB)^2+sB²; every binary uniform coupling is affine mixture Qp=pQsame+(1−p)Qanti. The difference is s(b−a)²(−1+s(a+b)²/2), while stable ceilings follow 1−A_p s+B_p s²<1. The quartic sign factor reduces through u=r+r^-1 to u²−2u−4, and completion of squares gives global fastest rate. Independently checked exact identities and rational qsame=10/9,qanti=17/18 at (a,b,s)=(1,2,1/3).
